author: Karl Rock
description:
A stranger in Karachi promised to cure my hair loss in just 30 days, but a local shopkeeper knew something wasn't right!

While exploring Karachi's Central Market in Pakistan, a stranger approached me with a miracle cure for my receding hairline. He seemed friendly and insisted he was simply offering advice. But I'd encountered this exact type of hair-loss scam before in Dubai, so I decided to play along and expose how it works.

The scam begins with a stranger pointing out your thinning hair or bald spot. He might claim his brother suffered from the same problem but managed to regrow his hair using a special natural remedy.

First, he recommends buying some inexpensive hair oil. But there's a catch! Apparently, the oil alone isn't enough. You'll also need two or three special herbal ingredients, and conveniently, he knows exactly where to buy them.
